title: Machine Learning Engineer Career Path
description: Comprehensive competency graph for transitioning into an industry-ready Machine Learning Engineer.

py_core.name: Python Programming & Software Engineering
py_core.description: Core Python syntax, OOP, data structures, algorithm efficiency, and modular coding.

py_data.name: Data Manipulation (NumPy & Pandas)
py_data.description: Vectorized computations with NumPy, data cleaning, transformations, and aggregation in Pandas.

math_linear_algebra.name: Linear Algebra for ML
math_linear_algebra.description: Vectors, matrices, dot products, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and matrix decomposition.

math_prob_stats.name: Probability & Applied Statistics
math_prob_stats.description: Probability distributions, Bayes theorem, expectation, variance, hypothesis testing, and maximum likelihood.

math_calculus.name: Multivariable Calculus & Optimization
math_calculus.description: Gradients, partial derivatives, chain rule, Hessian matrices, and gradient descent algorithms.

ml_foundations.name: Classical Machine Learning Foundations
ml_foundations.description: Supervised/unsupervised algorithms: linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, SVMs, evaluation metrics, and cross-validation.

dl_neural_nets.name: Deep Learning & Neural Architectures
dl_neural_nets.description: Multi-layer perceptrons, backpropagation, activation functions, regularization (dropout, batchnorm), and PyTorch fundamentals.

nlp_transformers.name: NLP & Transformer Architectures
nlp_transformers.description: Tokenization, self-attention mechanisms, Transformer architecture, BERT/GPT fine-tuning, and Hugging Face ecosystems.

cv_vision.name: Computer Vision & CNNs
cv_vision.description: Convolutional neural networks, image classification, object detection, segmentation, and OpenCV integrations.

ml_ops.name: MLOps, Model Serving & Pipelines
ml_ops.description: Containerizing models (Docker), FastAPI serving, model tracking with MLflow, CI/CD for ML, and drift monitoring.
